headers.//: No Git-based CMS noindexes its admin route by default. Without this, his login page appears in search results for his name. Paired with a disallow in robots.txt and a meta robots tag in the admin page itself: three mechanisms, because the failure is embarrassing and each costs one line. Verified against the live deployment before launch, never assumed.
The bare /admin path, without a trailing segment, is not matched by the pattern above.
